thread:
marta: Noticed a spike in missing child spans for the router service traces this morning. root spans are fine but a bunch of downstream edges are absent.
jason: Do you have an example trace id? any pattern in services or proto versions?
marta: trace: 0af3b7a2-8d9f-4c1a-9fbb-2a9d9f3c6e11. Looks like spans emitted by the sidecar collector are present but the exporter batches show truncated span lists.
priya: Observability alerts showed exporter retries around that time. observability-bot posted: "exporter-https-0: 413 response -> retry/backoff sequence" :warning:
kyle: 413? that usually means payload too large. Could be GRPC max message size or the proxy chopping gRPC streaming frames.
jason: Can you paste the collector logs around the failure window? command I ran: `kubectl logs -n telemetry collector-0 --since=30m | sed -n '1,200p' | grep exporter` — saw a repeated `rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted` line.
marta: exact lines:
```
2026-03-20T08:22:11Z exporter/https send failed: rpc error: code = ResourceExhausted desc = "max message size exceeded"
2026-03-20T08:22:11Z exporter/https retrying in 120ms
2026-03-20T08:22:12Z exporter/https send failed: http error 413 payload too large
```
priya: ok that's consistent. Our collector batches spans by default up to 32MB chunking, but downstream aggregator has a 16MB recv limit in the proxy. Seems like chunk negotiation not happening.
kyle: On the agent side we do continuous batching + KV cache. If an individual batch exceeded the proxy limit it should be split — but that splitting code only runs for http/1 exporter path. grpc exporter uses in-memory serialization and relies on gRPC max message size setting.
jason: Which component is doing the serialization? collector vs exporter lib?
marta: collector serializes OTLP protobuf on send. exporter uses the otlp-grpc client with default maxSendMsgSize unset. We've historically set GRPC_MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH in env in our deployments but a recent config refactor (rollout #4523) removed that env from the helm chart for telemetry.
priya: That rollout also changed routing policies for telemetry to prefer regional aggregator -> global fallback. If regional aggregator is hitting the smaller proxy, that explains region-specific spike.
observability-bot: "Region: eu-west-1 exporter-agg-2 reported increased 413s between 08:18-08:28 UTC. Related alerts: TLM-EXPORTER-413"
kyle: Quick mitigation: set OTEL_EXPORTER_GRPC_MAX_SEND_MSG_SIZE to 22000000 and OTEL_EXPORTER_GRPC_MAX_RECV_MSG_SIZE to 22000000 on collector. Also add client-side chunking fallback when serialization size > limit.
jason: Can we patch a helm values override and rollout to just eu-west first? I'm worried about global rollout causing transient overload.
marta: I'll cut a hotfix helm override and target eu-west nodepool. Creating PR now: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/helm-charts/pulls/2187
priya: Postmortem action items: 1) add unit test for grpc exporter chunking, 2) add an E2E trace with an artificially large batch to catch regression, 3) add alert rule to detect rising 413 ratio per exporter.
kyle: Also add a telemetry selftest in the console that runs a synthetic trace across routing paths and asserts no 413s on export.
jason: For the short term, disable the refactor that removed the env and pin max sizes in values.yaml. We should also confirm proxy (nginx/envoy) max_body limits.
marta: Confirmed proxy had `grpc_max_length: 16777216` (16MB). I'll raise it to 24MB post-deploy.
priya: Good. I'll own the postmortem doc and link the timeline. Assigning followups in the issue tracker: INFRA-TLM-762.
marta: Thanks — I'll monitor traces and report back in 30m. :thumbsup:
